step1_analysis.circuit_type: Programmable NMOS Current Sink / Switch Array
step1_analysis.description: An array of four independent NMOS transistors. Based on the paper's context, this is likely used as a programmable current sink to control the charge pump output current or as switches for a programmable capacitor bank in the VCO.

paper_reference.title: A 6.3–9-GHz CMOS Fast Settling PLL for MB-OFDM UWB Applications

Ron.description: ON resistance of the NMOS switch in the linear region (Vgs=1.8V, Vds=0.1V)

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using SKY130 typical NMOS parameters for W=5u, L=0.5u.

Id_sat.description: Saturation drain current when fully ON (Vgs=1.8V, Vds=1.8V)

sky130_expected.reasoning: Square-law estimation for saturation current in SKY130.

sky130_expected.calculation: Subthreshold leakage for standard Vth device at room temperature.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Typical OFF leakage for SKY130 1.8V devices is in the picoamp to nanoamp range depending on corner and temperature.

Vth.description: Threshold voltage of the NMOS transistors

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC characteristics (Vth, Id_sat, Ioff, Ron) of the NMOS array.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Programmable NMOS Array
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u

XM1 N1 C2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N2 C3 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N4 C1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N0 C0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}

* Voltage sources for drains
Vd0 N0 GND 1.8
Vd1 N4 GND 1.8
Vd2 N1 GND 1.8
Vd3 N2 GND 1.8

* Voltage sources for gates
Vc0 C0 GND 0
Vc1 C1 GND 0
Vc2 C2 GND 0
Vc3 C3 GND 0

.control
* 1. DC sweep for Vth, Id_sat, and Ioff
dc Vc0 0 1.8 0.01
let id0 = -i(Vd0)
meas dc vth0 when id0=10u
meas dc id_sat find id0 at=1.8
let ioff = id0[0]
print ioff

* 2. Operating point for Ron (Linear region)
alter Vd0 = 0.1
alter Vc0 = 1.8
op
let ron = 0.1 / -i(Vd0)
print ron

quit
.endc
